chunks: As for whatever occurs in it from Hārūn ibn Ḥamzah al-Ghanawī, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah have mercy on him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Yazīd ibn Isḥāq Shiʿr, from Hārūn ibn Ḥamzah al-Ghanawī.

key_terms.أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ: Abī al-Khaṭṭāb; part of the narrator identification in the chain.
key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Ṣaffār; a named transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.الْغَنَوِيِّ: Al-Ghanawī; the tribal attribution of Hārūn ibn Ḥamzah.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal term indicating narrated transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Hārūn ibn Ḥamzah al-Ghanawī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Hārūn ibn Ḥamzah al-Ghanawī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the source lineage of the narrations in the book.
